title: Manage software releases with greater visibility and control
description:
Jira is improving the Releases experience so you can find release information more easily, track changes over time, and use stages and approvals that match your release process. To get started Open your software project and select Releases from the sidebar.
	Use the controls at the top of the releases table to sort, group, or filter versions.
	Select a version to open its details page.
	Select History to review changes to the version.
